# Keel — Shop Management Dashboard

> Keel is a shop management dashboard for small businesses in Kenya. Track inventory, log sales, view reports, manage a website, handle social media, and accept payments — all from one place.

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/ — Landing page with features, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ
- Features: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/features — Full feature listing with 12 deep-dive sections
- Use Cases: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/use-cases — Real-world business situations and how Keel helps
- About: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/about — Who Framestudio is and why Keel was built
- Terms: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/terms — Terms of Service
- Help Center: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/help — User documentation, guides, and troubleshooting
- Blog: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/blog — Product updates, tips, and guides for small business owners
- Login: https://keel.framestudio.co.ke/login — Sign in or create an account

## Pricing

- Free trial: 7 days
- Basic: KSh 500/month — sales, inventory, expenses, stock alerts, basic reports
- Pro: KSh 1,000/month — live website, storefront, P&L reports, social scheduler, WhatsApp bots, QR codes, M-Pesa reconciliation, data export

## Key features

- Multi-tenant: each shop gets its own isolated dashboard
- Product inventory with barcode scanning (electronics/electricals)
- Sales logging with automatic stock deduction
- Receipt printing
- Expense tracking with categories
- Profit & loss reports with chart views
- Profit margins per product
- Live website with product catalogue, banners, gallery, chat widget
- QR code generation (products, website, WhatsApp)
- Social media post scheduler
- Service order management for laundries, salons, repair shops, etc.
- Customer profiles and order history
- M-Pesa statement reconciliation
- Dark mode
- Mobile-responsive
- Email/password and Google OAuth authentication

## Tech stack

- Frontend: React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind CSS 4, GSAP, Recharts
- Backend: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Edge Functions)
- Hosting: Vercel
- Payments: Paystack (subscription renewals only — KSh 500 Basic, KSh 1,000 Pro)
